settings.hero_alt: Please look at their little faces. All eight Evolution Companions plushes in a styled campaign scene.
settings.hero_title: Just wait until you’re holding one.
settings.hero_body: Those little faces are even more fun within reach. All eight plush companions, $160 for your complete set.
settings.story_title: You’ll notice a different favorite every time.
settings.story_body: Set your favorite beside you. A minute later, you’re reaching for another. With all eight at home, you can keep the whole little gang close.
settings.size_title: You’re not putting this one far away.
settings.size_body: Take a good look at that tiny smile. This is the one you reach for from the sofa, then carry back to bed with you.
settings.proof_body: Look closely at the tiny faces and fluffy hoods. These are the details you’ll keep reaching over to touch.
settings.final_body: No choosing just one. Your favorite gets the spot beside you; the other seven stay close.
settings.point_1_body: Peek under one hood, then another. See which tiny face you keep coming back to.
settings.point_2_body: Settle a soft little companion beside you. Choosing who stays closest is part of the fun.
settings.point_3_body: One beside your pillow, another by your chair. The whole set doesn’t have to stay in one place.
